title: Green and Inclusive Future International Brokerage Event
organiser: TÜBİTAK, with the Enterprise Europe Network
summary: A one-day in-person matchmaking event in Istanbul for 2027 Horizon Europe calls in Cluster 2, Cluster 4 Digital, the New European Bauhaus and two EU Missions.
details: The morning combines welcome addresses with four parallel thematic sessions that include project pitches. Pre-booked bilateral meetings run from 14:00 to 17:00, followed by a reception.

Target areas are Cluster 2 (Culture, Creativity and Inclusive Society), the New European Bauhaus, Cluster 4 Digital including the Chips and Smart Networks and Services joint undertakings, and the Climate-Neutral and Smart Cities and Cancer Missions.
Meetings are requested in advance on B2Match, and the platform stays open for online meetings until the end of 2027.
why: Useful for teams looking for partners across digital and social sciences topics in one place, including the chips and networks joint undertakings that rarely get their own brokerage. The long-running online platform also lets you follow up contacts after the day.
source_name: Green and Inclusive Future Brokerage Event (B2Match)
